project_info.theme: Sensitive bikini-area suitability close-up for beauty device
project_info.color_palette: Warm Sand, Sunlit Gold, Lemon Yellow, Skin Tones, Cream

main_subject.detail: A beachy close-up of a woman in a pale yellow bikini holding a yellow Halio device against her upper thigh/hip area, with circular line graphics and claims about cooling comfort and suitability for sensitive bikini skin.
main_subject.style: Sun-kissed beauty-tech close-up, sensual yet clean summer promo, body-crop lifestyle device ad

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'Phù hợp cho vùng da bikini nhạy cảm' and 'Mát lạnh, Dịu da'.
items: Top Left: Cream text block over warm beach-toned background.
Top Right: Cream bracelet on the wrist and cropped wooden lounge or deck structure in the background.
Bottom Left: Close crop of the woman's torso and pale yellow bikini strap with pink lettering.
Bottom Right: The phrase 'Mát lạnh, Dịu da' beside the device, framed by a thin circular line graphic.
Center/Background: Yellow Halio device held vertically in the hand against sunlit skin with a soft sandy backdrop.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Golden skin sheen, beach heat, soft summery shadows, tactile close-up realism

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity summer lifestyle product photography

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a close-up summer beauty-device demo. Centerpiece is a yellow Halio device held against the upper thigh and hip area of a woman in a pale yellow bikini. Background is a warm beach or sun deck setting with soft sandy tones. Surrounding elements: thin circular line graphics, text 'Phù hợp cho vùng da bikini nhạy cảm', and 'Mát lạnh, Dịu da'. Keep the tight body crop, sunlit skin texture, and cooling-sensitive-zone message. Technical style: high fidelity summer lifestyle product photography, warm natural sunlight, golden skin sheen and tactile close-up realism, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
